summary: Tested product analytics (tracker, /api/analytics/collect, all /api/admin/analytics/* endpoints, admin /admin/analytics UI: all 6 tabs, filters, heatmap desktop/mobile, frustration Watch, replay modal), patient guidance (Start-here checklist, guided tour, dismiss, persistence) with 2 NEW registered patients (desktop + 390x844 mobile), and chat screening progress through a full live AI screening. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass. Frontend: all requested flows work. Main problem: no 'leave' event when the page unloads (reload, closing the tab, typing a URL). Because of that the exit page of every visit gets no time-on-page, and the heatmap background can show the wrong or a blank page.

minor.issue: The snapshot pageview is picked with sort=[('at',-1)]. 'at' is the server time the batch arrived, so it is the same for every event in a batch and it can pick a pageview the user was only on for a moment (e.g. the instant /dashboard -> /onboarding redirect after register). When there is no leave event, until=None and the replay is paused at t+8s, which can already be the next page after a hard navigation. Seen: the desktop /dashboard heatmap background showed the /chat page (Health Chat nav active) with an empty main area (snapshot until=None), and the mobile /dashboard background was blank under the staging banner. My guess for the mobile case is that it picked the instant pre-redirect /dashboard pageview; I could not confirm this in the DB because my direct Mongo query failed with an auth error. Fix: sort by t, and prefer a pageview that has a leave event with duration >= 2-3s, then pause near until-300.

Nothing checks that a session belongs to the user. Any signed-in user who posts with someone else's session_id adds events and replay chunks to that session ($setOnInsert keeps the original user_id), so a replay can be poisoned or mixed. Fix: if analytics_sessions already has this session_id with a different user_id, ignore the batch or reject it.

Any path segment of 6+ characters that contains a digit becomes ':id'. For example '/test27-04c8' was stored as '/:id'. That is fine for the current routes but fragile: a real slug such as 'covid19' or 'step2guide' would be merged into ':id'.

ui_bugs.issue: A 'leave' event is only sent on SPA route changes or stopAnalytics, not on pagehide / visibility hidden / reload. So the last page of every visit has no duration: the overview shows /chat avg time '—' even though it had 3 views. Journeys exits are still recorded, but heatmap snapshots without a leave event pause on the wrong page. Fix: in onHide/pagehide push a 'leave' with the duration before flush(true), and reset since when the tab becomes visible again.

maskTextSelector is 'main, [data-private]'. Content shown through portals (ConfirmDialog, components/admin/ui modals, toasts, the GuidedTour tooltip) is rendered under document.body, outside <main>, so its text is recorded unmasked. For example, a confirm dialog that names a medicine would appear in plain text. The sidebar and header (user's name) are also unmasked. Consider adding data-private to portal roots or masking '[role=dialog], .toast'.

Every tap on a non-interactive element counts as dead, including each tap of a rage burst (3 taps = 1 rage + 3 or 4 dead). The target is the nearest data-testid ancestor, so a tap on the card heading is reported as the whole card ('getting-started'). This makes the frustration lists noisy and coarse.

The 'Summary' step (index 4) is never 'active': it jumps straight from 'Other details' active to all done. This is cosmetic; you could make it active when the assistant reply count reaches the soft limit.

design_issues.screen: Mobile /chat reached from a Start-here step
issues: The scroll position carries over from the dashboard: the page opens part-way down and the 'New Screening' button is out of view. Scroll to the top on route change.
Date of birth uses the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar. This was there before.
Period, Who and Include-demo are kept in React state, not in the URL, so a reload or a shared link resets them. Only tab and path are in the URL.

passed_flows: Register new patient -> onboarding -> skip -> /dashboard shows Start here with 4 steps, 0 of 4 done; guided tour highlights chat -> medications -> pill_id -> find_care, Next/Got it; tour_done saved (not shown after reload); desktop + mobile 390x844 placement correct
Opening /find-care ticks find_care (1 of 4); a chat message ticks chat (2 of 4); dismiss hides the card and it stays hidden after reload

Live AI screening: steps go active 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 (symptom -> timing -> severity -> details), the AI followed the topic order, finished after 6 questions with 'Tap **Download Report**'; all 5 steps done; bold renders as <strong>, no raw **
Tracker batches pageview/leave/click(target=data-testid)/rage/dead with vw; replay chunks sent; super admin made 0 collect requests and the backend ignores admin posts

Admin analytics: the empty state hides demo accounts by default; with Include demo on, stats and pages table render; heatmap link -> ?tab=heatmaps&path=/dashboard with the select set; desktop/mobile toggle, tap count, Most tapped list, rrweb iframe rendered

Funnel shows 6 steps with % and drop-offs, a stuck count, and the B2C toggle changes the total; Journeys transitions/entries/exits; Frustration rows + Watch opens the replay at that moment; Replays list + frustrated filter + Watch -> rrweb-player plays with text masked; close works
action_items: Send a 'leave' event (with duration) on visibilitychange hidden / pagehide in lib/analytics.js so exit pages get time-on-page and heatmap snapshots have an 'until'
Heatmap snapshot: sort the pageview by t, not at; prefer pageviews with a leave event and dwell >= 2-3s; pause near until
Mask text in portals (dialogs/toasts/modals) in rrweb recordings (data-private on portal roots or extend maskTextSelector)
Check session ownership in /api/analytics/collect (reject or ignore a session_id owned by another user)
Optional: don't count the taps of a rage burst as dead clicks; make the Summary screening step active near the end; scroll to top on route change
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_collect: the session_id is not bound to the user, which lets a replay be poisoned (see backend minor issue)
heatmap: the 'recorded' distinct query has no date or demo filter. That's harmless, but on a large collection it scans every session with has_replay
funnel: chat_messages.distinct with $in over every chat session id (up to 100k) will be slow as data grows; an aggregation keyed on user_id would be better
summary pages are limited to 40 and frustration to 50 rows, so a rarely visited page won't appear in the heatmap page select
Backend log shows an earlier startup NameError: ANALYTICS_RETENTION_DAYS was used in startup indexes before it was defined. It has been resolved and the backend is running now.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; heatmap snapshot accuracy and missing unload leave event)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use include_demo=true or the toggle because every test user is demo. Paths with digits normalize to ':id', so use letter-only test paths. Don't use networkidle. The AI chat takes about 6 turns to complete (~10-20s each). Re-check the heatmap snapshot on /dashboard desktop+mobile after the leave-on-unload and snapshot-selection fixes.
